uc.hookHint.en: The text shown with the ad

uc.hint.zh: 已剪好的竖版广告直接上传，不会重新剪辑或转码。上传后在“投放”里选它作为广告内容。
uc.hint.en: A finished vertical ad is used exactly as uploaded — never re-cut or re-encoded. Pick it as ad content in Launch.

lpx.metaLinkNote.zh: Meta 广告带的是这部剧的 Meta 链接（source=meta，并带上本次广告活动的 campid）。TikTok 的宏只有 TikTok 会替换，不能用在 Meta 上。
lpx.metaLinkNote.en: Meta ads carry this drama's Meta link (source=meta, with this campaign's campid). TikTok's macros are filled by TikTok alone and are never sent to Meta.
